tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /sgrub thabs rgya mtsho nas nye bar phyung ba sgrub thabs nor bu'i phreng ba'i rjes gnang gi cho ga dang bcas pa bzhugs so//

sgrub thabs rgya mtsho nas nye bar bsdus pa'i sgrub thabs nor bu'i phreng ba zhes bya ba/ bla ma dang lhag pa'i lha tshogs rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// gdod nas spros pa nyer zhi zhing*// kha sbyor yan lag bdun ldan pa'i// rdo rje 'chang dbang la btud nas// sgrub thabs nor bu'i phreng ba spel/ dbang thob cing dam tshig la gnas pa'i sngags pas/ rdo rje theg pa'i lam gyi 'jug ngogs chen po yang dag par nyams su blang ba ni/ gnas yid dang mthun par bris sku bkram/ mchod gtor rdzas dang rdo dril sogs 'du byas la/ stan bde bar kha shar du phyogs pas skyabs sems tshad med bzhi sngon du btang nas/ bgegs kyi gtor ma chus sbyangs la/ oṃ āḥbigh+nān+ta kṛta ྄hūm̐ gis bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las byung ba'i rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhu ba las byung ba'i gtor ma dwangs shing thogs pa med pa/ zag pa med pa'i bde ba khyad par can bskyed nus pa nam mkha'i khams dang mnyam par gyur par dmigs/ oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharma ṇāṃ ad+ya nut+pan+na twā ta oṃ āḥhūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ gsum dang*/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta a wa lo ki te/ oṃ sam+bha ra sam+bha ra hūm̐ phaṭa/ gsum dang*/ de bzhin gshegs pa bzhi'i mtshan brjod/ dril bu gsil zhing*/ gang zhig mtshan mo rgyu ba yi// 'byung po rnams dang sha za dang*| |srin po sha rjen za ba dang*// sems can rnam pa sna tshogs dang*// ljon shing gel pa sogs gnas dang*// de dang de la gtor ma ni// bza' ba sha chang la phud dang*// 'bras chan 'bras bu mang po dang*// mchod sbyin 'di yis mgu byos la// gnod pa'i bsam pa zhi ba dang*// sems can rnams la phan pa'i sems// de ring phyin chad bskyed par bgyi// rgyan gyi brgyan bzhin du ni chos spyod cing*// dul zhing yang dag sdom la tshangs par spyod| |'byung po kun la chad pa spangs pa ste// dge slong dge sbyong de yin bram ze'ang de// mtshon chas mi 'jig gang yang med// 'tsho ba'i srog la kun kyang 'dzem/

/rang gi lus la dpe long la// gzhan la gnod pa ma byed cig /oṃ chen po'am chung ngu gang dag gis| |lus la mngon par gnod byed pa'i// nad de nye bar sol mdzod la// gdon khyod rang gi gnas su dengs// sarba bhū ta swa s+thā naṃ gats+tsha/ zhes gtor ma gtsang sar phul/ mchod pa bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+rūṃ las rin po che'i snod zab cing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du/ oṃ ā ཿhūm̐ zhu ba las byung ba'i rdo rje'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog /bdug spos/ snang gsal/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa/ byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po'i rnam thar las byung ba'i mchod pa'i sprin lta bu rgya nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam zhing*/ dus 'khor ba ji srid rgyun mi 'chad pa mchod pa'i sprin phung bsam gyis mi khyab par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ āḥhūm̐/ de bzhin du/ pā d+yaṃ/ puṣ+paṃ/ dhū paṃ/ ā lo kaṃ/ gan+dhaṃ/ ne+ai wi d+yaṃ/ shapad sbyar bas byin gyis brlabs/ rang 'khor lo'i dbang phyug tu gsal ba'i thugs kar rang rig gi sa bon nyi ma'i 'od ltar 'bar zhing 'od phreng phyogs thams cad du khyab cing 'bar ba las byung ba'i steng thams cad rdo rje'i gur dang de'i nang du bla bre/ 'og thams cad rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ logs kyi phyogs thams cad rdo rje'i dra ba chen po dang*/ de dag gi bar mtshams rnams rdo rje'i mda'i dra ba dang*/ phyi rol rdo rje'i ra ba/ de'i phyi rol ye shes kyi me dpung bar mtshams med par dum bu gcig tu 'bar zhing 'khrugs pa bsrung ba'i 'khor lo yangs shing rgya che bar gyur/ oṃ me dī ni badz+rī bha wa badz+ra bhan+da badz+ra pra kā ra badz+ra pañja bi tā na sa ra dzā la traṃ saṃ traṃ badz+ra dz+wa la a na lārka hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon las dri ma med pa'i 'od kyi tshogs spros pas phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi rgyal ba thams cad 'khor lo'i dbang phyug gi rnam par sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs dpag tu med pas bskor ba mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/

badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ 'od zer snying khar thim par gyur/ badz+ra ā sa na tiṣ+ṭha s+t+waṃ/ gang gi drin gyis bde chen nyid// skad cig nyid la 'char ba gang*// bla ma rin chen lhag pa'i lha// rdo rje can zhabs pad la 'dud/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta gu ru tsa ra ṇa u pa s+thānā ya āt+ma nāṃ nir+ya ta yā mi/ zhes phyag 'tshal/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ā di de wa ta sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā nas shap+ta'i bar sbyar bas mchod/ bstod par 'os pa thams cad la// zhing rdul kun gyi grangs snyed kyi// lus btud pa yis rnam kun tu// mchog tu dad pas bstod par bgyi// zhes bstod/ byang chub snying por mchis kyi bar/ */nas rim pa bzhin du bslab par bgyi// zhes dang*/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// nas 'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog /lan gsum gsum sbyar/ tshogs zhing rnams rang la thim par gyur par dmigs/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig /sems can thams cad sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral bar gyur cig /sems can thams cad sdug bsngal med pa'i bde ba dang mi 'bral bar gyur cig /sems can thams cad nye ring chags sdang gnyis dang bral ba'i btang snyoms chen po la yun ring du gnas par gyur cig /ces yun ring du bsgom/ de'i ngang nas/ oṃ shū n+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ chos dang chos nyid gzung ba dang 'dzin pas bsdus pa'i chos thams cad rang bzhin stong pa chen po 'od gsal ba bde ba dam pa'i rang bzhin nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las bsrung ba'i 'khor lo yangs pa'i dbus su/ zhes pa yan chad ni sgrub thabs thams cad kyi sngon du bya ba'i yan lag thun mong pa nyid do// dngos gzhi lha so sor bsgom pa la/ dang po dpal rdo rje gdan gyi sgrub thabs ni/ zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi gdan gyi steng du hūm̐ la ā di kā di dkar pos bskor ba yongs su gyur pa las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor nya yongs su gang ba'i steng du hūm̐ yongs su gyur pa las/

rdo rje ser po lte ba hūm̐ gis mtshan pa de thams cad 'dres pa las rang nyid bcom ldan 'das rdo rje gdan gser btso ma lta bu zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas sa gnon gyi phyag rgya dang*/ g.yon mnyam bzhag na bza' dmar po sku la mnabs pa/ zhi ba'i bdag nyid can mtshan dpes brgyan pa/ zhabs rdo rje skyil krung gis phung po dang*/ nyon mongs pa dang*/ 'chi bdag dang*/ lha'i bu'i bdud rnams ser dmar nag dang sngon po'i mdog can gyis bteg pa'i seṅge'i khri dang sna tshogs pad ma dang rdo rje la bzhugs pa/ bcom ldan 'das kyi g.yas su byams pa ser po ral pa'i cod pan can/ g.yas rin po che'i rnga g.yab dang*/ g.yon klu shing gi yal ga me tog dang bcas pa bsnams pa/ g.yon du 'jig rten dbang phyug dkar po g.yas rin po che'i rnga g.yab dang*/ g.yon pad+ma 'dzin pa de gnyis bcom ldan 'das kyi zhal la blta zhing 'khod pa/ bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan gnyis la k+ṣiṃ dkar po/ snyan gnyis la dz+riṃ sngon po/ shangs gnyis la khaṃ ser po/ ljags la gaṃ dmar po/ dpral bar kaṃ ljang gu/ nu ma'i dbus su paṃ dkar po rnams zla ba nya gang ba re re'i dbus su gnas pa/ rang gi snying gar zla ba la haṃ yig dkar po yongs su gyur pa las rdo rje'i lte bar zla ba'i steng du hūm̐ dkar po rnams yongs su gyur pa las/ ye shes sems dpa' rang 'dra ba/ bcom ldan 'das kyi dpral bar oṃ las 'khor lo dkar po'i lte bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥlas pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar zla ba la āḥdamar po/ lte ba'i steng du zla ba la dbus su hūm̐ las rdo rje nag po'i lte bar zla ba la hūm̐ nag pos mtshan par gyur par dmigs so// ye shes pa spyan drangs pa ni/ de dag gi dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ snying khar hūm̐ sngon po de gsum las 'od zer sna tshogs 'phros pas ye shes sems dpa'i tshogs dang dbang gi lha rnams mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/

nyer spyod lngas mchod/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis ye shes pa dang dam tshig pa gnyis su med par gyur/ dbang gi lhas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣiñca tu māṃ/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ dbang gi lhas rin po che'i bum pa bdud rtsis gang ba bsnams nas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ zhes dbang bskur sku gang dri ma dag /chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las rang rigs kyi bdag po gtso bor gyur pa'i rigs lngas dbu brgyan/ dbang gi lha rnams rang nyid la thim par gyur par dmigs/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā nas shapada'i bar gyis mchod/ dpal ldan rdo rje'i sku 'chang ba// rdo rje'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod// dpal ldan rdo rje'i gsung 'chang ba// rdo rje'i gsung la phyag 'tshal bstod// dpal ldan rdo rje'i thugs 'chang ba// rdo rje'i thugs la phyag 'tshal bstod// bstod par 'os pa thams cad la// zhing rdul kun gyi grangs snyed kyi// lus btud pa yis rnam kun tu// mchog tu dad pas bstod par bgyi// zhes bstod/ lha sku sgyu ma lta bu la sems gtad nas yun ring du bsgom/ des ngal na/ thugs kar pad zla'i steng du lha rang gi sa bon gyi mthar sngags phreng lha'i mdog mthun gyis bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad mchod cing byin rlabs bsdus khams gsum pa'i sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ mya ngan las 'das pa'i go 'phang la bkod/ phrin las thams cad sgrub par byas/ tshur 'dus sngags phreng sa bon dang bcas pa la thim par gyur par bsam/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra hūm̐ swā hā/ zhes nus thang bzla'o// thun las ldang ba'i tshe/ yi ge brgya pa lan gsum bzlas nas/ ye shes pa rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs la/ dam tshig pa dang snod bcud rang bzhin gyis dag pa'i dmigs med 'od gsal bde ba chen po'i rang gshis kyi ngo bo stong pa nyid du gyur par dmigs la mnyam par bzhag

/mthar/ bsod nams 'di yis khams gsum gyi sems can thams cad kyis de bzhin gshegs pa'i ye shes myur du thob par gyur cig /ces bsngo bas rgyas btab nas spyod lam chos dang mthun par spyod cing ldang ngo*// de ni rdo rje gdan pa'i sgrub thabs te/ 'di'i dngos gzhi lha bsgom pa dang*/ bzla bya'i sngags ma gtogs/ ye shes pa dang dbang lha spyan drangs pa dang*/ gnyis su med par bstim pa/ dbang bskur/ rgyas gdab/ mchod bstod/ sngags bzla ba'i dmigs pa/ thun tha ma'i gshegs bsdu/ bsngo smon dang bcas pa ni sgrub thabs phyi ma kun la'ang tshig don 'di nyid rigs 'gres la bya'o/// / ༈ /gnyis pa spyan ras gzigs yi ge drug ma'i sgrub thabs ni/ pad zla'i gdan la hrīḥdakar po las 'od 'phros/ sems can thams cad kyis thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i nyon mongs pa'i tshogs ma lus pa sbyangs tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ bdag nyid 'jig rten dbang phyug sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ phyag g.yon pad+ma/ g.yas bgrang phreng*/ phyag gzhan gnyis thugs kar thal mo sbyar ba/ 'od dpag med kyi ral pa'i cod pan can/ de'i g.yas su sras nor bu 'dzin pa sku mdog dang phyag mtshan gtso bo lta bu dri ba'i phyag gis thal mo sbyar ba/ gtso bo dang gdan gcig tu 'khod pa/ g.yon du pad+ma gzhan gyi steng du yum yi ge drug ma gtso bo nyid lta bu/ gsum ga'ang dar dang rin po ches brgyan pa sems dpa'i skyil mo krung gis 'khod pa'o/ */de nas/ oṃ ma hā su kha badz+ra satwa dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ su ra te s+t+waṃ/ a la la la la hoḥ aḥ.aḥ.aḥ zhes bya ba'i sngags kyis byin gyis brlab bo// ye shes pa spyan drangs pa sogs sgrub thabs kyi yan lag bsdu ba'i mthar thug pa bsngo ba dang bcas pa ni rdo rje gdan pa lta bu'o// bzla bya'i sngags ni/ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/ zhes pa nyid do/ yi ge 'bum du bzlas shing 'bum gnyis dang gsum gyis mtshams med pa lnga yang byang la bye bas ni dngos grub thob par 'gyur ro// slob dpon lhan cig skyes pa'i rol pas mdzad pa'o/// /

༈ /gsum pa spyan ras gzigs kha sar+pa ṇi'i sgrub thabs ni/ paṃ yig las sna tshogs chu skyes kyi steng du/ aṃ las zla ba'i gdan la hrīḥdakar po 'od kyi tshogs nam mkha' gang ba'i rang bzhin can yongs su gyur pa las/ ze'u 'bru sdong pos brgyan pa'i chu skyes dkar po hrīḥs mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid bcom ldan 'das kha sar+pa ṇi bsil zer bye ba'i 'od las rab tu dkar ba ral pa'i cod pan can 'od dpag tu med pas mtshan pa/ sems skyil gyis bzhugs pa dar dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ brgyad gnyis lon pa'i na tshod can zhal 'dzum pa/ phyag g.yon sdong bu dang bcas pa'i chu skyes dang*/ g.yas mchog sbyin gyi rtse mo nas bdud rtsi'i rgyun 'dzag par sred can kha dog gnag cing lto ba che la rid pa khab kyi kha can rnams kha steng du gdang ba'i khar 'bab pas tshim par mdzad pa'i snying rje'i ngang tshul dang sgeg pa'i nyams can/ shin tu zhi ba gru 'dzin gyi ri la bzhugs pa/ de'i mdun du sgrol ma ljang gu/ g.yon ut+pal dang g.yas mchog sbyin/ g.yas su nor bzang gzhon nu gser mdog g.yas thal mo 'dud cing g.yon po ti/ rgyab tu khro gnyer can ser mo phyag bzhi'i g.yas gnyis phyag 'tshal ba'i tshul dang bgrang phreng*/ g.yon gnyis dbyug gu rtse gsum pa dang spyi blugs 'dzin pa/ g.yon du rta mgrin g.yas phyag 'tshal ba'i tshul dang g.yon dbyug pa thogs pa/ zhi ba gnyis dar dang rin po ches brgyan pa zhi ba'i tshul can/ khro bo gnyis khro tshul cha lugs thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa/ 'khor bzhi po gtso bo'i zhal la blta ba/ gtso 'khor thams cad kyi spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ snying khar hūm̐ nag po'i mtshan par bsam/ sgrub thabs yan lag gzhan thams cad ni rdo rje gdan pa bzhin la/ bzla bya'i sngags ni/ oṃ hrīḥswā hā/ zhes so/ kha sar+pa ṇi'i sgrub thabs slob dpon blo gros zhabs kyis so/// /

༈ /bzhi pa spyan ras gzigs seṅge sgra'i sgrub thabs ni/ paṃ las pad+ma dang a las zla ba'i gdan la/ a dkar po las seṅge dkar po'i steng du oṃ las pad+ma dkar po'i lte bar hrīḥs mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las/ bdag nyid 'phags pa seṅge sgra dkar po zhal gcig spyan gsum ral pa'i cod pan can 'od dpag tu med pas mtshan pa/ rgyal po rol pa'i stabs kyis gdong lnga'i steng na 'gying ba/ stag lpags kyi sham thabs can/ de bzhin gshegs pa lnga spro zhing rol pa'i dpa' bo lnga dang zla ba phyed pas brgyan pa/ phyag g.yon pad+ma dkar po'i steng du ral gri dkar po dang de dang nye bar pad+ma dkar po'i steng du me tog dri bzang po sna tshogs pas yongs su gang ba'i thod pa dkar po/ phyag g.yas pad+ma dkar po'i steng na sbrul dkar pos dkris pa'i dbyug pa dkar po rtse gsum pa 'dzin pa dar gyi cod pan can no// sgrub thabs kyi yan lag gzhan thams cad ni rdo rje gdan pa nyid ltar ro// bzla bya'i sngags ni/ oṃ āḥhrīḥsingha nā da hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes so/ seṅge sgra'i sgrub thabs a wa dhū ti pa gnyis med rdo rje zhabs kyis so/// / ༈ /lnga pa 'jam dpal ngag gi rgyal po'i sgrub thabs ni/ paṃ las pad+ma a las zla ba'i gdan la muṃ yig dmar ser yongs su gyur pa las bdag nyid 'jam dpal dbyangs seṅge'i steng na bzhugs pa/ sku mdog ser po dar dang rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs pas brgyan pa/ phyag gnyis chos kyi 'khor lo'i phyag rgya can g.yon ut+palas mtshan pa/ dbu skra zur phud gsum pa sgeg cing 'dzum pa/ de'i g.yas su nor bzang gzhon nu dang*/ g.yon du gshin rje'i gshed nye bar gnas pa/ sgrub thabs gzhan rdo rje gdan pa ltar la/ bzla bya'i sngags ni/ oṃ wā gī shwa ri muṃ/ zhes so/ ngag gi rgyal po'i sgrub thabs so/// / ༈ /drug pa 'jam dpal dkar po'i sgrub thabs ni/ sna tshogs pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la/

maṃ yig dkar po las rang nyid 'jam dpal dkar po dpa' bo gcig tu grub pa zla ba'i kha dog lta bu dar dang rin po che'i tshogs du mas brgyan pa/ phyag g.yas mchog sbyin dang*/ g.yon ut+pal sngon po 'dzin pa skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ zhi 'dzum sgeg bzhad rol pa'i nyams can chu shel gyi 'od zer lta bu 'bar zhing spro ba/ cho ga'i yan lag rnams rdo rje gdan pa ltar ro// bzla bya'i sngags ni/ oṃ wākyai dan+na maḥ zhes so// zla ba drug gis ngag gi dbang phyug 'grub par 'gyur ro// dpa' bo gcig tu grub pa'o/// / ༈ /bdun pa 'jam dpal mtshan yang dag par brjod pa'i sgrub thabs ni/ sna tshogs pad+ma'i steng du a las zla ba'i gdan la muṃ yig dmar zhing dkar ba las sangs rgyas mang po spro ba dang bsdu ba'i rnam pa can yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid 'jam pa'i dbyangs dmar zhing dkar ba rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ dbus zhal dmar po/ g.yas sngo/ g.yon dkar ba/ phyag bzhi'i dang po gnyis ral gri dang po ti/ 'og ma gnyis mda' dang gzhu 'dzin pa/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan can/ mtshan so gnyis dang*/ dpe byad brgyad cus mdzes pa/ gzhon nu lang tsho dang ldan pa'i snying khar rdo rje sems ma dkar mo sems skyil can g.yas rdo rje dang g.yon dril bu 'dzin pa/ smin mtshams su rin chen rdo rje ma ser mo phyag gnyis spyi bor me tog gi phreng ba 'dzin pa/ mgrin par pad+ma rdo rje ma dkar dmar g.yon 'gying ba dang bcas pas pad+ma'i sdong bu 'dzin cing g.yas pas de'i 'dab ma kha 'byed pa/ spyi bor las kyi rdo rje ma ljang gu phyag gnyis rdo rje rtse gsum pa rang gi spyi bor 'dzin pa/ bzhi ka'ang pad zla'i gdan la bzhugs pa/ cho ga'i yan lag rnams rdo rje gdan pa dang 'dra la/ bzla bya'i sngags ni/ oṃ sarba dharma a bhā wa/ swa bhā wa bi shud+dhaḥ a āḥ aṃ āḥ pra kṛ ta pa ri shud+dhaḥ sarba dharmaḥ ya du ta sarba ta thā ga ta dz+nyā na kā ya/

mañju shrī pa ri shud+dhi ta/ mu pā dā ya ti/ aṃ āḥ sarba ta thā ga ta hṛ da ya/ ha ra ha ra/ oṃ hūm̐ hrīḥbha ga wān/ dz+nyā na murti wā gī shwa ra/ ma hā bā tsa| sarba dharma ga ga na/ a ma la/ su pa ri shud+dhaḥ dharma dhā tu dz+nyā na garbaha āḥ zhes pa'i sngags kyis dang po dang*/ bar dang*/ tha mar byin gyis rlabs pa sngon du 'gro bas mtshan yang dag par brjod pa thun mtshams rnams su lan gsum re sogs skyil krung bcas te bskyed rim dang ldan pas bklag na dngos grub gnyis myurabar 'grub par byed pa gdon mi za'o// 'jam dpal mtshan brjod kyi sgrub thabs so/// / ༈ /brgyad pa phyag rdor gtum po'i sgrub thabs ni/ sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan la hūm̐ las rang nyid lag na rdo rje gtum po mig sman dang bung ba ltar gnag pa/ spyan gsum/ zhal gdangs ljags 'dril khro gnyer bsdus pa/ sma ra dang ral pa 'phyang ba/ g.yas rdo rje gsor ba/ g.yon sdigs mdzub bsgreng ba/ dar ljang gu'i na bza' dang*/ rgyan ma lus pas brgyan pa/ khams gsum las rnam par rgyal ba'i gzugs can no| |sgrubs thabs kyi yan lag gzhan ni rdo rje gdan pa ltar ro/ /bzla bya'i sngags ni/ oṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa sarba duṣ+ṭāṃ ta ka ha na da ha pa tsa hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces so/ rdo rje gtum po'i sgrub thabs slob dpon mi bskyod rdo rjes mdzad pa'o/// / ༈ /dgu pa phyag rdor 'byung 'dul gyi sgrub thabs ni/ sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan la hūm̐ dang rdo rje yongs su gyur pa las/ bdag nyid gsang ba'i bdag po 'byung po 'dul byed sku mdog nag po g.yas rdo rje gdengs shing g.yon sdigs mdzub kyis thugs kar rdo rje'i zhags pa 'dzin pa/ skra dmar ser 'bar zhing klu brgyad kyis brgyan pa stag sham 'phyang ba/ g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang ba/ thod pa'i phreng ba can/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i klong na bzhugs pa/ sgrub thabs kyi yan lag rnams rdo rje gdan pa bzhin no// bzla bya'i sngags ni/

hūm̐ badz+ra phaṭa/ ces so// slob dpon 'jig rten gsum gyi rdo rjes mdzad pa'i 'byung 'dul sgrub thabs so/// / ༈ /bcu pa mi g.yo ba'i sgrub thabs ni/ pad+ma dkar po dang nyi ma'i gdan la hūm̐ las rang nyid gtum chen mi g.yo ba zar ma'i me tog lta bu mi gzhan gyis mi g.yo ba zhal gcig spyan gnyis dmar zhing zur gyis gzigs pa/ mi bzad pa'i zhal chen po/ rin po che'i dbu rgyan can/ mche bas ma mchu mnan pa mgo phreng gis brgyan cing*/ g.yas ral gri dang g.yon zhags pa dang bcas pa'i thugs kar sdigs mdzub mdzad pa/ sbrul dkar po se ral khar 'phyang zhing*/ stag lpags kyi sham thabs grol ba/ rin po che sna tshogs pas brgyan cing zhabs g.yas pa'i mthil sa la reg cing g.yon cung zhig bteg pa'i nyi ma'i 'od kyi phreng ba can no// sgrub thabs kyi yan lag gzhan ni rdo rje gdan pa nyid kho na'o// bzla bya'i sngags ni/ oṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces so/ 'di bzlas pa tsam gyis gdul dka' 'dul ba dang*/ 'gro ba rnams dbang du bya ba dang*/ las rab 'byams thams cad 'grub par gsungs so// mi g.yo ba'i sgrub thabs so/// / ༈ /bcu gcig pa sgrol ma ljang mo'i sgrub thabs ni/ pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la tāṃ las ut+pal sngon po tāṃ gyis mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las/ bdag nyid 'phags ma sgrol ma ljang mo margad lta bu/ phyag gnyis g.yas mchog sbyin dang*/ g.yon ut+pa la'i yu ba 'dzin pa rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan cing skyil krung phyed pas bzhugs pa/ dar gyi lhab lhub can no| |sgrub thabs kyi yan lag rnams ni rdo rje gdan pa bzhin no// bzla bya'i sngags ni/ oṃ tā re tut+tā re tu re swā hā/ zhes sa/ོ /'dis ni mchog tu rnyed par dka' ba'i sangs rgyas nyid kyang myur du thob par byed do// sgrol ma sngon mo'i sgrub thabs so/// / ༈ /bcu gnyis pa sgrol ma dkar mo'i sgrub thabs ni/

pad+ma dkar po dang zla ba'i gdan la tāṃ yig dkar po yongs su gyur pa las/ bdag nyid lha mo sgrol ma yid du 'ong ba/ g.yas mchog sbyin dang g.yon ut+pal 'dzin pa/ ston ka'i zla ba lta bur shin tu dkar ba/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs pas brgyan pa/ bcu drug lon pa'i na tshod can/ sangs rgyas thams cad bskyed pa'i bdag nyid can du bsgom/ sgrub thabs kyi yan lag rnams ni rdo rje gdan pa ltar bya'o// bzla bya'i sngags ni/ oṃ tā re tut+tā re tu re swā hā/ zhes so// 'dis ni dus min 'chi ba sogs kyi 'chi ba 'joms par byed do// sgrol ma dkar mo'i sgrub thabs so/// / ༈ /bcu gsum pa dug sel ma'i sgrub thabs ni/ pad+ma dmar po dang zla ba'i steng du dz+riṃ yig ser po las/ rang nyid 'phags ma dug sel ma rtsa zhal dang sku mdog ser po/ zhal g.yas sngo/ g.yon dkar ba/ phyag drug g.yas gsum ral gri rdo rje mda'/ g.yon gsum sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i zhags pa dang dug gi me tog dang gzhu bsnams pa/ gdengs ka rgyas pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su gnas pa/ sbrul dang rin chen dang mdzes pa'i dar gyis brgyan pa/ gzhon nu ma'i mtshan nyid 'bar ba/ rol pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ sgrub thabs kyi yan lag rnams rdo rje gdan pa kho na nyid do// bzla bya'i sngags ni/ oṃ dzāṃ gu lī sarba bi ṣa pra ma sha na phuḥswā hā/ zhes so// 'di'i mtshan thos pa tsam gyis kyang rgyu ba dang mi rgyu ba'i dug thams cad 'joms par 'gyur ro// dug sel ma'i sgrub thabs so/// / ༈ /bcu bzhi pa ral gcig ma'i sgrub thabs ni/ sna tshogs pad+ma'i steng du ṭāṃ las thod pa hūm̐ yig nag pos mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las| bdag nyid bcom ldan 'das ma ral pa gcig ma yan lag thams cad nag po zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa kun nas dmar ba'i spyan gsum pa/ stag gi pags pa'i na bza' can/ dbu la thod pa'i phreng ba bcings ba/

skra kham pa gyen du brdzes pa/ mche ba gtsigs shing ljags 'dril ba/ lto ba 'phyang zhing lag 'gro nag po'i rgyan sna tshogs can/ brgyad gnyis lon pa'i na tshod can dkar 'dzin mtho zhing mkhregs pa/ do shal dang dpung rgyan g.yer kha me tog gi phreng bas yan lag ma lus pa brgyan pa/ phyag g.yas gnyis gri gug dang ral gri g.yon gnyis ut+pal dang thod pa bsnams pa/ sgrub thabs kyi yan lag rnams ni rdo rje gdan pa ltar ro// bzla bya'i sngags ni/ oṃ hrīṃ trīṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/྄ ces so/ mtshams med pa lnga byas kyang sngags 'di bye ba bzlas na bcom ldan 'das kyi go 'phang thob par gsungs so// ral gcig ma'i sgrub thabs so/// / ༈ /bco lnga pa tsun+da'i sgrubs thabs ni/ sna tshogs pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la tsaṃ las rang nyid 'phags ma tsun+da ston zla lta bu/ zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa g.yas mchog sbyin/ g.yon po tis mtshan pa'i pad+ma/ phyag lhag ma dag gis lhung bzed 'dzin pa/ rgyan dang na bza' sna tshogs pas rnam par brgyan pa/ rdo rje sems dpa'i cod pan can/ sems can dpag tu med pa'i don mdzad pa'i sku'i bdag nyid can/ cho ga'i lhag ma rnams rdo rje gdan pa nyid ltar ro// bzla bya'i sngags ni/ oṃ tsa le tsu le tsun+de swā hā/ zhes so// 'phags ma tsun+da'i sgrub thabs so/// / ༈ /bcu drug pa 'od zer can ma'i sgrub thabs ni/ maṃ ser po las mya ngan med pa'i shing maṃ ser po dang bcas pa yongs su gyur pa las/ bdag nyid mya ngan med pa'i shing gi 'od zer can ma dzam+bu nā da'i kha dog ltar shin tu ser ba/ phyag g.yas mchog sbyin dang*/ g.yon mya ngan med pa'i shing gi yal 'dab 'dzin pa/ do shal la sogs pa'i rgyan du ma dang*| dar gyi na bza' klubs pa/ lang tsho gzhon shing mdzes pa/ gser lta bu'i phag pa'i rgyab tu sna tshogs pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la 'gying bag dang bcas pas bzhugs pa/ cho ga'i yan lag rnams ni rdo rje gdan pa dang mtshungs so// bzla bya'i sngags ni/

oṃ mā ri ts+ye maṃ swā hā/ 'dis chom rkun 'ching ba sogs las rab 'byams 'grub par gsungs so// 'od zer can ma'i sgrub thabs so/// / ༈ /bcu bdun pa lo ma gyon ma'i sgrub thabs ni/ sna tshogs pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la paṃ yig ljang gu las skyes pa'i rang nyid ri khrod lo ma can rtsa zhal dang sku mdog ljang gu/ g.yas nag /g.yon dkar ba/ phyag g.yas gsum rdo rje/ dgra sta/ mda'/ g.yon gsum yal ga /gzhu/ sdigs mdzub dang bcas pas zhags pa bsnams pa/ zhal khro zhing bzhad pa lang tsho gzhon pa phreng ba bcings shing stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ lto ba cung zad 'phyang zhing skra brdzes pa/ nad dang gdon ma lus pa zhabs kyis mnan pa/ don 'grub kyi cod pan can/ sgrub thabs lhag ma rnams ni rdo rje gdan pa dang mtshungs so// bzla bya'i sngags ni/ oṃ pi shā tsi par+ṇa sha wa ri sarba dz+wa ra pra sha ma ni hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces so// 'dis ni rims nad thams cad srung ba sogs phan yon dpag tu med do// lo ma gyon ma'i sgrubs thabs so/// / ༈ /bco brgyad pa sher phyin ma dkar mo'i sgrub thabs ni/ sna tshogs pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la praṃ yig dang pad+ma yongs su gyur pa las/ bdag nyid bcom ldan 'das ma shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma kun+da'i mdog lta bu lung dang rtogs pa'i gzugs can ma rin po che'i cod pan can/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i po tis mtshan pa'i chu skyes gnyis g.yas dang g.yon dag gi nang du langs pa bsnams pa'i phyag gnyis chos 'chad kyi phyag rgya mdzad pa/ rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa lang tsho gzhon zhing dar la bab pa/ na bza' dang rin po che'i rgyan du ma spras pa/ so sor snang pa tsam rab tu 'phro ba'i sna tshogs pa'i 'od zer gyi tshogs kyis nam mkha' gang ba'i mar me'i phreng ba lta bu thogs pas shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma dpag tu med pa spro zhing bsdu ba'i sbyor bas thams cad rang bzhin gcig tu gyur par mos/

cho ga lhag ma rdo rje gdan pa bzhin no// bzla bya'i sngags ni/ oṃ praṃ swā hā/ zhes sam yang na/ oṃ pi tsu pi tsu pra dz+nyā war+dhā ni| dz+wa la dz+wa la me dha war+dhā ni/ dhi ri dhi ri/ bud+dhi war+dhā ni swā hā/ zhes so/ 'dis ni nyi ma gcig la sho lo ka 'bum zin pa sogs gsungs so// sher phyin dkar mo'i sgrub thabs so/// / ༈ /bcu dgu pa sher phyin ser mo'i sgrub thabs ni/ paṃ las pad+ma zla ba'i gdan la dhī yig ser po gza'i bdag po lta bu'i 'od ldan yongs su gyur pa las/ bdag nyid bcom ldan 'das ma shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma dzam+bu chu bo'i gser lta bu/ sna tshogs pa'i gos dang rin thang med pa'i rin po che du mas yongs su brgyan pa/ phyag g.yas chos 'chad dang g.yon ut+pa la'i steng na shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i glegs bam bzhugs pa'i yu ba nas 'dzin pa/ lang tsho dar zhing sgeg pa'i nyams can/ rdo rje skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ nyi ma stong gi 'od las kyang ches cher 'bar ba'i 'od kyi snang ba phyogs kun tu spro ba/ sgrub thabs kyi yan lag gzhan rnams ni rdo rje gdan pa bzhin no// bzla bya'i sngags ni/ oṃ pradz+nye ma hā pradz+nye shru ti smri ti bi dza ye dhīḥswā hā/ zhes so// sa ya bcu bdun bzlas na pha rol tu phyin pa'i don dang mthun par 'gyur ro// sher phyin ser mo'i sgrub thabs so/// / ༈ /nyi shu pa dbyangs can dkar mo'i sgrub thabs ni/ pad+ma dkar po khru bdun pa'i 'phang dang mnyam pa'i steng du zla ba'i gdan la hrīḥdakar po las chu skyes hrīḥs mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid bcom ldan 'das ma dbyangs can ma chen mo ston ka'i zla ba'i 'od kyi rnam pa can/ phyag g.yas mchog sbyin dang g.yon sdong bu bcas pa'i chu skyes dkar po bsnams pa/ zhal 'dzum zhing shin tu brtse ba'i bdag nyid can/ tsan+dan dkar po dang me tog gi na bza' mnabs pa/

mu tig dkar po'i do shal dang rin po che sna tshogs pa'i rgyan gyis mdzes pa bcu gnyis lon pa'i na tshod can/ nu ma 'bur zhing nang rgyas pa/ sked pa byin gyis phra ba/ nang nas 'od zer gyi tshogs 'phros pas 'jig rten gsum po snang bar mdzad pa/ de'i mdun du shes rab ma/ g.yas su blo can ma/ rgyab tu blo gros ma/ g.yon du dran pa ma rnams sku mdog dang phyag mtshan rgyan cha lugs bcom ldan 'das ma lta bu zhal gtso mo la mngon par phyogs pa/ sgrub thabs lhag ma rnams ni rdo rje gdan pa ltar ro// bzla bya'i sngags ni/ oṃ hrīḥm hā mā yaṃ ge ma hā swa ra swa t+yai na maḥ zhes so// 'di gso sbyong blangs nas mi smra bar rgyun du bzla zhing bya ba gzhan gyis bar ma chod par zla ba gcig bzlas na dbyangs can ma'i ngag 'thob par 'gyur la/ zla ba gsum gyis tshangs spyod nyams pas kyang 'grub la/ zla drug bzlas na dbyangs can ma dang mtshungs par 'gyur ro// dbyangs can dkar mo'i sgrub thabs so/// / ༈ /nyer gcig pa dbyangs can ma dmar mo'i sgrub thabs ni/ pad+ma dmar po khru bdun gyi tshad tsam gyi steng du aṃ las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dkar la dmar ba'i steng du doḥyig dmar po las chu skyes dmar po doḥyig dmar pos mtshan pa las 'od 'phros 'gro ba drug po yang dag par bsdus nas sems can rnams byang chub la bkod/ rdo rje dbyangs can ma'i rnam par doḥyig la rab tu zhugs pa yongs su gyur pa las/ bdag nyid rdo rje dbyangs can ma lha mo sku mdog rtsa zhal dmar po/ g.yas dkar/ g.yon nag /skra dmar ser gyen du brdzes pa/ zla ba dmar mo'i gdan la g.yas brkyang gis bzhugs pa/ phyag drug g.yas kyi dang pos shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i po tis mtshan pa'i chu skyes dkar po/ gnyis pas ral gri/ gsum pas gri gug /g.yon dang pos 'khor lo dkar po rtsibs brgyad pa/ gnyis pas rin po che'i pi waṃ rgyud stong dang ldan pa/

gsum pas tshangs mgo/ dar dang rin po che sna tshogs pa'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ nyi ma 'bum phrag las kyang ches rmad du byung ba'i 'od zer gyis mtha' yas pa'i sems can rnams kyis mi shes pa'i mun pa 'joms par byed pa/ sgrub thabs gzhan rnams ni rdo rje gdan pa nyid do// bzla bya'i sngags ni/ oṃ pi tsu pi tsu pra dz+nyā war+dhā ni/ dz+wa la dz+wa la me dha war+dhā ni/ dhi ri dhi ri bud+dhi war+dhā ni swā hā/ zhes sngags 'bum gnyis bzlas nas dkar po'i tshes gcig nas nya'i bar du zla ba shar ba nas nub pa'i bar rtse gcig tu bzlas shing bsgom na sngar ma thos pa'i bstan bcos ji snyed pa mngon du byed cing*/ nyi ma re rer gzhung stong phrag re 'dzin nus pa dang*/ rgol ba ngan pa thams cad 'joms pa dang*/ lha dang mi rnams dga' bar 'gyur ro// gshin rje'i gshed nag po'i rgyud nas gsungs pa ste/ rdo rje dbyangs can ma dmar mo'i sgrub thabs so/// / ༈ /nyer gnyis pa jo mo khro gnyer can ma'i sgrub thabs ni/ pad zla'i gdan la bh+riṃ yig ser po las/ bdag nyid khro gnyer can gser lta bu zhal gcig spyan gsum pa lang tsho gzhon pa phyag g.yas dang po mchog sbyin/ gnyis pas bgrang phreng*/ g.yon dang pos dbyug gu rtse gsum/ gnyis pas spyi blugs bsnams pa/ 'od dpag med pa'i cod pan can/ dar dang rin po ches brgyan pa/ cho ga gzhan rnams rdo rje gdan pa ltar ro// bzla bya'i sngags ni| oṃ bh+riṃ ku ḍe+ai swā hā/ zhes so// khro gnyer can gyi sgrub thabs so/// / ༈ /nyer gsum pa ku ru kul+le dmar mo'i sgrub thabs ni/ pad+ma dmar po dang ro'i snying khar nyi ma'i gdan la hrīḥyig dmar po las ut+pal dmar po'i ze'u 'bru hrīḥdamar pos mtshan pa las 'od 'phros don gnyis byas 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid rig byed ma pad+ma rā ga'i lhun po ltar dmar ba skyil krung phyed pa'i gar gyis 'gying ba/

brgyad gnyis lon pa'i na tshod can/ skra dmar ser gyen du brdzes pa/ dbu la sangs rgyas lnga bzhugs pa/ thod skam lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ mgo rlon lnga bcu rtsa gcig gi do shal can/ zhal mche ba gtsigs pa/ ljags 'dril spyan gsum dmar la zlum pa g.yon du lta ba khro sgeg chags pa'i nyams can/ rus pa'i phyag rgya lnga 'chang ba/ rtsa ba'i phyag gnyis me tog dmar po'i gzhu dang*/ ut+pal dmar po kha ma bye ba'i mde'u can gyi mda' rno ba'i gzhu 'gengs pa/ g.yas 'og mas ut+pal dmar po'i lcags kyu dang*/ g.yon 'og mas pad+mas mtshan pa'i zhags pa dmar po 'dzin pa/ rang 'od nyi ma 'bum gyi 'od phreng spros pas phyi rol du dur khrod chen po brgyad kyis yongs su bskor ba/ cho ga'i lhag ma rnams rdo rje gdan pa ltar ro// bzla bya'i sngags ni/ oṃ ku ru kul+le hrīḥswā hā/ zhes so// sngags tsan+dan dmar po'i phreng ba dang bcas bye ba phrag drug bzlas na 'gro drug la 'khor los sgyur zhing sems can rnams dbang du 'gyur ro// dgyes pa rdo rje'i rtogs pa las byung ba ku ru kul+le'i sgrub thabs slob dpon lhan cig skyes pa'i rol pas mdzad pa'o/// / ༈ /nyer bzhi pa ku ru kul+le dkar mo'i sgrub thabs ni/ pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la hrīḥdakar po las byung ba'i ut+pal dkar po hrīḥs mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las/ bdag nyid rig byed ma dkar mo phyag g.yas ut+pala'i phreng ba dang*/ g.yon bdud rtsi'i bum pa 'dzin pa/ spyan gsum pa sems dpa'i skyil krung gi bzhugs pa/ mu tig gi do shal dang rin po che dang dar sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/ klu chen po brgyad kyi dbu skra dang do shal rna ba mchod phyir thogs pa/ do shal phyed pa rkang gdub phyag gdub dpung pa rnams spras pa/ sku las bdud rtsi 'dzag pa/ thugs snying rje chen pos brlan pa/ cho ga'i lhag ma rnams rdo rje gdan pa ltar bya'o// bzla bya'i sngags ni/

oṃ ku ru kul+le hrīḥ bā da bā da bā khā di ni swā hā/ zhes so// sems brtan zhing yid chags pas sngon du bzlas pa 'bum byas nas/ zla ba phyed gsum du nyin re khri phrag re bzlas na snyan ngag mkhan du 'gyur ro// dug zhi bar byed do// 'bum phrag nyer gcig bzlas nas nyer gcig gis sa dkar la sngags nas lag pas dril te lan nyer gcig sngags la gang gi mgor lag pas byin na mi de rmongs pa yin yang snyan ngag mkhan du 'gyur ro// 'khor rnams kyang rgol bas zil gyis gnon par mi 'gyur la/ 'jam dpal dang mtshungs par 'gyur te/ sngar ma thos pa'i bstan bcos thams cad shes par 'gyur ro// 'di la sbyin sreg rnam pa du ma sogs las tshogs mang du mchis kyang ma bris so// ku ru kul+le dkar mo'i sgrub thabs so/// / ༈ /nyer lnga pa gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ma'i sgrub thabs ni/ sna tshogs pad+ma dang zla ba'i steng du bh+rūṃ las rnam par rgyal ba'i mchod rten gyi bum pa'i dbus su sna tshogs pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la bh+rūṃ dkar po yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ma sku mdog dang rtsa zhal dkar po/ g.yas zhal ser g.yon sngon po spyan gsum gsum mnga' ba/ mche bas ma mchu mnan pa/ phyag g.yas bzhis sna tshogs rdo rje dang*/ chu skyes dmar po la gnas pa'i 'od dpag med/ mda'/ mchog sbyin/ g.yas bzhis sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i zhags pa/ gzhu/ mi 'jigs pa/ bum pa 'dzin pa| dar dang rin po che'i rgyan du mas brgyan pa/ 'od zer dkar po'i phreng ba 'khrigs pa/ de'i g.yas su 'jig rten dbang phyug dkar po/ g.yon pad+ma/ g.yas rnga yab/ g.yon du phyag na rdo rje sngon po/ g.yon ut+pal la gnas pa'i rdo rje/ g.yas rnga yab/ gnyis ka dar dang rin po ches brgyan pa bsgreng ste 'gying ba/ shar du mi g.yo ba g.yas ral gri/ lhor 'dod rgyal g.yas lcags kyu/ nub tu dbyug sngon can g.yas dbyug pa/

byang du stobs po che g.yas rdo rje/ bzhi ka'ang g.yon sdigs mdzub can/ sku mdog sngon po spyan gsum mche gtsigs g.yon brkyang stag lpags kyi smad dkris pa/ skra kham pa gyen du brdzes pa/ klu brgyad kyis brgyan pa pad nyir bzhengs pa/ gtso bo'i steng phyogs su gtsang ris kyi lha gnyis kyis bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa thogs nas bdud rtsi'i rgyun 'bebs shing lus phyed sprin las thon pa/ cho ga lhag ma rnams rdo rje gdan pa ltar la/ bzla bya'i sngags ni/ oṃ a mṛ te a mṛ totabha we a mṛ ta bi kran+te a mṛ ta gā te a mṛ ta gā mi ni a mṛ ta ā yurda de swā hā/ zhes so// rnam par rgyal ma'i sgrub thabs so/// / ༈ /nyer drug pa gtsug tor gdugs dkar mo gzhan gyis mi thub ma'i sgrub thabs ni/ sna tshogs pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la oṃ yig dkar po yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid bcom ldan 'das ma gdugs dkar mo gzhan gyis mi thub pa rtsa zhal dang sku mdog dkar po/ zhal g.yas sngo/ g.yon dmar/ spyan gsum gsum ldan pa/ phyag g.yas gsum 'khor lo/ lcags kyu/ mda'/ g.yon gsum rdo rje dkar po/ sdigs mdzub bcas pa'i zhags pa dang*| mda' gzhu bsnams pa khro bo'i lta stangs dang bcas pas gdon thams cad 'joms par byed pa/ lha'i gos dang rgyan sna tshogs pas brgyan pa/ rnam snang gi cod pan can rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ cho ga lhag ma rnams rdo rje gdan pa ltar ro// bzla bya'i sngags ni/ oṃ si tā ta pa tre a pa rā dzi te sarba gra he a nut+t+rā sa ya ha na ha na druṃ druṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ zhes so// gtsug tor gdugs dkar mo can gyi sgrub thabs so/// / ༈ /nyer bdun pa rdo rje tsartsi ka'i sgrub thabs ni/ pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa dang nyi ma'i gdan la hūm̐ las byung ba'i rdo rje'i lte bar tsa yig dmar pos mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid rdo rje tsartsi ka dmar mo zhal gcig spyan gsum pa/

skyil krung phyed pa'i gar stabs kyis ro'i gdan la bzhugs pa/ sku lus rid cing mche ba gtsigs pa 'jigs su rung ba/ mi mgo'i phreng ba'i rgyan gyis mgul pa'i phyogs rnam par brgyan pa phyag rgya lngas spras pa/ mi bskyod pa'i cod pan can skra grol ba/ phyag g.yas gsum rdo rje/ ral gri| 'khor lo/ g.yon gsum thod pa/ nor bu chu skyes 'dzin pa/ sgrub thabs kyi yan lag rnams rdo rje gdan pa ltar ro/ /bzla bya'i sngags ni/ oṃ badz+ra tsartsi ka hūm̐ swā hā/ zhes so/ /tsartsi ka'i sgrub thabs so/// / ༈ /nyer brgyad pa so sor 'brang ma'i sgrub thabs ni/ sna tshogs pad+ma dang a las zla ba'i gdan la praṃ yig ser po las 'od 'phros don gnyis byas 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid so sor 'brang ma chen mo sku mdog dang rtsa zhal dzam+bu nā' da lta bu/ zhal g.yas dkar/ rgyab sngo/ g.yon dmar ba/ spyan gsum gsum mnga' ba/ phyag g.yas bzhis ral gri| 'khor lo/ rtse gsum/ mda'/ g.yon bzhis dgra sta/ zhags pa/ rdo rje gzhu bsnams pa/ dar dang rin po che sna tshogs pas brgyan pa/ 'od kyi dkyil 'khor dmar po can rol pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ cho ga lhag ma rnams rdo rje gdan pa bzhin no// bzla bya'i sngags ni/ oṃ ma ṇi dha ri badz+ri ṇi ma hā pra ti swa re hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ so sor 'brang ma'i sgrub thabs so/// / ༈ /nyer dgu pa rma bya chen mo'i sgrub thabs ni/ sna tshogs pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la maṃ ljang gu yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid rma bya chen mo rtsa zhal dang sku mdog margad lta bu| zhal g.yas nag /g.yon dkar ba/ spyan gsum gsum pa/ phyag g.yas gsum rma bya'i mjug sgro/ mda'/ mchog sbyin/ g.yon gsum rin po che'i rnga yab/ gzhu 'gying bar bkang nas gnas pa la bum pa 'dzin pa/ sna tshogs pa'i rgyan dang gos kyis klubs pa sgeg cing lang tsho la bab pa'i cha lugs can/ zla ba la rgyab brten pa/ skyil krung phyed pas bzhugs pa don grub kyi cod pan can/

cho ga'i lhag ma rnams rdo rje gdan pa bzhin no// bzla bya'i sngags ni/ oṃ ma hā mā yu ribid+yā rā dz+nyī hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces so// rma bya chen mo'i sgrub thabs so/// / ༈ /sum cu pa stong chen rab 'joms ma'i sgrub thabs ni/ sna tshogs pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la bruṃ yig dkar po yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid stong chen mo rab tu 'joms pa shel lta bu/ phyag drug g.yas gsum ral gri| mda'/ mchog sbyin/ g.yon gsum gzhu/ zhags pa/ dgra sta bsnams pa/ sna tshogs pa'i dar dang rin po ches brgyan pa/ lang tsho gsar la bab pa sgeg pa la sogs pa'i nyams can/ rnam snang gi cod pan can zla ba'i rgyab yol dang ldan pa/ skyil krung phyed pas bzhugs pa/ cho ga lhag ma rnams rdo rje gdan pa bzhin la/ bzla bya'i sngags ni/ oṃ ma hā sa ha sra pra ma ra ni bruṃ hūm̐| zhes so/ */stong chen rab 'joms kyi sgrub thabs so/// / ༈ /so gcig pa gsang sngags rjes su 'dzin ma'i sgrub thabs ni/ sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan la hūm̐ nag po yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid gsang sngags rjes su 'dzin ma sku mdog rdo stang zil lta bu/ phyag g.yas gnyis rdo rje dang*/ mchog sbyin/ g.yon gnyis dgra sta dang*/ zhags pa bsnams pa/ dar dang rin po che du mas brgyan cing phyed skyil can/ mi bskyod pa'i cod pan 'chang ba/ nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la rgyab brten pa/ cho ga'i lhag ma rnams rdo rje gdan pa bzhin la/ bzla bya'i sngags ni/ oṃ āḥm hā man+t+ra nu dha ri nī hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes so// gsang sngags rjes su 'dzin ma'i sgrub thabs so/// / ༈ /so gnyis pa bsil ba'i tshal chen mo'i sgrub thabs ni/ sna tshogs pad nyir dz+riṃ yig dmar po yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid bsil ba'i tshal chen mo sku mdog pad+ma rā ga lta bu/ phyag g.yas dang pos phreng ba/ gnyis pas mchog sbyin/ g.yon dang pos rdo rje'i lcags kyu/ gnyis pas thugs kar po ti 'dzin pa/

'od dpag med pa'i cod pan can/ rin po che'i rgyan dang dar gyi na bza' 'chang ba/ nyi ma'i rgyab yol can/ skyil krung phyed pas bzhugs pa/ cho ga'i lhag ma rnams rdo rje gdan pa bzhin no// bzla bya'i sngags ni/ oṃ āḥm hā shī ta bā ti dz+riṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes so// bsil ba'i tshal gyi sgrub thabs so/// / ༈ /so gsum pa 'phags ma rdo rje gan+dha ri'i sgrub thabs ni/ sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan la hūm̐ nag po las skyes pa'i rang nyid rdo rje gan+dha ri rtsa zhal dang sku mdog nag po/ zhal lhag ma g.yas skor du dkar ser dmar ljang sngo ba/ spyan bco brgyad gdangs shing zhal rnams mche ba gtsigs pa dbu skra kham pa gyen du 'phyo ba/ phyag g.yas drug rdo rje/ dril bu/ ral gri/ rtse gsum/ mda'/ rdza mkhan gyi 'khor lo/ g.yon pa drug kha ṭ+wāṃ ga /lcags kyu| gzhu/ dgra sta/ zhags pa rnams dang*/ sdigs mdzub thugs kar 'dzin pa/ zhabs g.yon brkyangs pa/ cho ga gzhan rnams rdo rje gdan pa ltar ro// bzla bya'i sngags ni/ oṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ swā hā/ zhes so| |rdo rje gan+dha ri'i sgrub thabs so/// / ༈ /so bzhi pa rdo rje lcags sgrogs kyi sgrub thabs ni/ sna tshogs pad zlar hūm̐ yig ljang gu las skyes pa'i rang nyid rdo rje lcags sgrogs rtsa zhal dang sku mdog ljang ser| g.yas zhal sngon po/ g.yon zhal dkar po/ spyan dgu pa/ phyag g.yas gsum rdo rje/ lcags sgrogs/ mda'/ g.yon gsum sdigs mdzub/ zhags pa/ gzhu thogs pa| zhal cung zad gdangs pa dar dang rin po che'i rgyan ma lus pa 'chang ba/ byi la'i pags pa'i stod g.yogs can/ gdug pa can gyi sems can rnams 'dul ba'i bdag nyid/ cho ga'i lhag ma rnams rdo rje gdan pa bzhin no// bzla bya'i sngags ni/ oṃ badz+ra shrī kha le swā hā/ zhes so// rdo rje lcags sgrogs ma'i sgrub thabs so/// / ༈ /so lnga pa rgyal mtshan rtse mo'i dpung rgyan gyi sgrub thabs ni/

sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan la rang gi rig pa zla nyi kha sbyor gyi bar du dhāṃ yig ser po las 'od 'phros don gnyis byas 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid rgyal mtshan gyi rtse mo'i dpung rgyan g.yul las sgrol bar byed pa'i lha mo sku mdog dang rtsa zhal dzam+bu chu bo'i gser lta bu yid du 'ong ba/ zhal g.yas dmar g.yon dkar ba/ steng zhal du ba'i mdog can shin tu 'jigs pa/ khro zhing zhabs g.yon brkyangs pa/ lto ba 'phyang zhing spyan bcu gnyis dmar la zlum zhing mdzes pa na bza' sngon po can/ phyag g.yas dang pos ral gri/ gnyis pas 'khor lo/ g.yon pa dang pos sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i zhags pa nag po/ gnyis pas rdo rjes mtshan pa'i gtun shing dkar po bsnams pa/ sku'i phyogs g.yon du rtse gsum la 'khyud pa| cho ga lhag ma rnams ni rdo rje gdan pa nyid do// bzla bya'i sngags ni/ oṃ sarba gra ha nak+ṣa tra dh+ye me ka ra ṇi swā hā/ zhes so// rgyal mtshan rtse mo'i dpung rgyan gyi sgrub thabs paṇ+ḍi ta dbu ma pa ka ru dhe chos kyi 'byung gnas blo gros kyis mdzad pa'o/// / ༈ /so drug pa nor rgyun ma'i sgrub thabs ni/ sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan la baṃ yig ser po yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid lha mo nor rgyun ma gser btso ma lta bu lang tsho gzhon zhing rgyan dang na bzas rnam par brgyan pa/ phyag g.yon 'bras kyi snye ma dang rin po che sna tshogs pa'i char 'bebs bzhin pa'i bum pa/ g.yas mchog sbyin mdzad pa/ rin 'byung gi cod pan can phyed skyil gyis gnas pa/ dpag tu med pa'i grogs mo'i tshogs kyis bskor ba/ cho ga lhag ma rdo rje gdan pa ltar ro// bzla bya'i sngags ni/ oṃ bā su dha ra rat+na ni dha na k+ṣe tre swā hā/ zhes so// nor rgyun ma'i sgrub thabs so// rdo rje phag mo'i sgrub thabs 'dir ma bris so/// / ༈ /so bdun pa byams pa'i sgrub thabs ni/

sna tshogs pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la mai ser po yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid thub chen rgyal ba byams pa mgon po sku mdog dang rtsa zhal dzam+bu nā da'i lhun po lta bu/ zhal g.yas nag g.yon dkar ba/ phyag dang po gnyis chos kyi 'khor lo'i phyag rgya/ g.yas gnyis pa mchog sbyin| g.yon gnyis pa klu shing gi me tog dang snye ma bsnams pa/ rin po che dang lha'i gos kyis brjid pa/ sems dpa'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ cho ga gzhan rnams rdo rje gdan pa nyid do// bzla bya'i sngags ni/ oṃ mai tri swā hā/ zhes so// byams pa'i sgrub thabs so/// / ༈ /so brgyad pa dzaṃ bha la'i sgrub thabs ni/ sna tshogs chu skyes dang nyi ma'i steng du dzaṃ ser po las/ rang nyid dzaṃ bha la gser lta bu khro zhing dgyes pa'i nyams can/ phyag g.yas shing thog bi dza pū ra ka dang*/ g.yon rin po che'i char 'bebs pa'i ne'u le bsnams pa/ sangs rgyas rigs lnga'i cod pan can/ ut+pal sngon po'i do shal dang rin po che du ma'i rgyan dang lha rdzas kyi gos mang pos klubs pa/ zhabs dag gis dung gi mgo dang pad+ma'i sdong gis gter chen po mnan pa/ cho ga'i lhag ma rnams rdo rje gdan pa dang 'dra'o// bzla bya'i sngags ni/ oṃ dzaṃ bha la dza len+d+rā ya swā hā/ zhes so// dzaṃ bha la'i sgrub thabs slob dpon tsan+d+ra go mis mdzad pa'o/// / ༈ /so dgu pa u tsuṣ+ma dzaṃ bha la'i sgrub thabs ni/ sna tshogs pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la dzaṃ nag po las/ rang nyid u tsuṣ+ma mi'u thung gi gzugs rigs ngan rna ba ma phug pa mdog nag pa skra kham pa gyen du 'greng ba/ lus thung bar byed cing khro gnyer can mche ba dang ldan pa klu brgyad kyis brgyan pa/ phyag g.yon rin po che sna tshogs skyug pa'i ne'u le dang*/ g.yas thod pa khrag gis gang ba bsnams pa/ nor sbyin ser po rgyan du mas brgyan pa bsgyel ba mgo g.yas su phyogs pa'i steng du 'gying ba/ 'od kyi phreng ba 'khrugs pa'i bdag nyid do// cho ga lhag ma rnams rdo rje gdan pa dang mtshungs pa nyid do// bzla bya'i sngags ni/

oṃ in+d+ra nī mu khaṃ bh+ra ma ri swā hā/ oṃ dzaṃ luṃ swā hā/ zhes so// u tsuṣ+ma dzaṃ bha la'i sgrub thabs so// dzaṃ bha la ser nag gnyis la chu sbyin 'bul ba ni gzhan ltar bya'o/// / ༈ /bzhi bcu pa rta mgrin gyi sgrub thabs ni/ sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan la haṃ yig dmar po yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid khro bo rta mgrin rtsa zhal dang sku mdog bskal pa'i me ltar 'bar ba/ rtsa zhal khro zhing bzhad pa/ g.yas zhal sngon po ljags 'dril ba/ g.yon zhal dkar po mche ba gnyis kyis ma mchu mnan pa/ sbrul gyis brgyan pa/ zhabs rol pa'i stabs can/ phyag g.yas bzhis rdo rje/ dbyug pa/ mchog sbyin| mda'/ g.yon bzhi'i dang po dang gsum pa bzhi pas sdigs mdzub/ pad+ma/ gzhu/ gnyis pas rang gi nu ma bzung ba/ stag lpags kyi sham thabs grol ba/ mi bskyod pa'i cod pan can/ cho ga gzhan rdo rje gdan pa ltar ro// bzla bya'i sngags ni/ oṃ ha ya grī ba swā hā/ zhes so// rta mgrin gyi sgrub thabs so/// / ༈ /zhe gcig pa gshin rje'i gshed dmar po'i sgrub thabs ni/ sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi ma'i dbus su ma he'i steng du aṃ dmar po las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor hūm̐ dmar pos mtshan pa de yongs su gyur pa las mi mgo rlon pa ser pos mtshan pa'i dbyug pa dkar po hūm̐ byu ru lta bus mtshan pa de thams cad gcig tu 'dres shing yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid gshin rje'i gshed dmar po dus mtha'i byin za lta bu khro gnyer g.yo zhing spyan gsum 'khrugs pa/ sma ra ag tshom ral pa dmar ser me ltar 'bar ba/ phyag g.yas mgo rlon ser pos brgyan pa'i dbyug pa dkar po dang*/ g.yon thod pa khrag gis yongs su gang ba 'dzin pa/ klu brgyad kyis brgyan pa/ stag gi sham thabs 'phyang ba/ de'i pang du yum zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma myos byed kyis myos shing khu ba 'dzag pa/ stag sham can gri thod thogs pa/ sna tshogs pa'i rgyan can/

bcom ldan 'das dang lhan cig tu kha sbyor gyi sbyor bas g.yon brkyang gis 'khril ba/ yab yum bskal pa'i me 'bar ba'i dbus na gnas pa/ cho ga gzhan rnams rdo rje gdan pa ltar ro// bzla bya'i sngags ni/ oṃ hrīḥṣ+ṭi bi kṛ tā na na hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ snying po'o// oṃ ya mān+ta ka hūm̐/ zhes nye snying ngo*// gshin rje'i gshed dmar po'i sgrub thabs so/// / ༈ /zhe gnyis pa gshin rje'i gshed nag po'i sgrub thabs ni/ sna tshogs pad+ma'i lte bar oṃ yig dmar po las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dmar po'i steng du hūm̐ las rdo rjes mtshan pa'i dbyug pa sngon po hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros| don gnyis byas 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid gshin rje'i gshed nag po g.yas brkyang gis ma he'i gdan la gnas pa/ phyag g.yas rdo rjes mtshan pa'i dbyug pa nag po 'phyar zhing*/ g.yon sdigs mdzub mdzad pa/ khro tshul rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ sgrub thabs lhag ma rdo rje gdan pa bzhin no// bzla bya'i sngags ni/ oṃ hrīḥṣ+ṭi bi kṛ tā na na hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes so| |gshin rje'i gshed nag po'i sgrub thabs so/// / ༈ /zhe gsum pa gshin rje'i dgra nag po'i sgrub thabs ni/ sna tshogs pad nyir hūm̐ las rdo rje nag po hūm̐ gis mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las/ bdag nyid skad cig gis gshin rje'i dgra nag po ma he'i steng du g.yon brkyang gis gnas pa/ char sprin ltar gnag cing khro gnyer bsdus shing zhal 'jigs pa/ sma ra smin ma ag tshom ral pa'i tshogs gyen du gzings pa/ zhal gsum ljags bskyod pa mche ba gtsigs shing spyan dgu 'bar ba/ bsus pa 'phyang zhing stag gi sham thabs can/ mi'u thung ltar mi sdug pa nyi ma 'bum gyi 'od 'bar ba/ phyag g.yas gsum rdo rje/ ral gri/ gtun shing*/ g.yon gsum ro langs/ sta re/ zhags pa 'dzin pa/ hūm̐ gis mgrin pa gang ba/ khro bcas 'jigs byed nga rgyal thams cad rlog par byed pa/

cho ga gzhan rdo rje gdan pa bzhin no// bzla bya'i sngags ni/ oṃ hrīḥṣ+ṭi bi kṛ tā na na hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ zhes so// gshin rje'i dgra nag gi sgrub thabs so/// / ༈ /zhe bzhi pa gshin rje mthar byed chen mo'i sgrub thabs man ngag dang ldan pa ni/ sna tshogs pad+ma'i lte bar zla ba'i ngogs su mtshan so gnyis kyi rang bzhin ā di dkar po phrag gnyis dang*/ de'i steng du nyi ma'i ngogs su dpe byad brgyad cu'i rang bzhin kā di so bzhi'i mthar ḍa ḍha da dha ya la bsnan pa phrag gnyis dmar pos mtshan pa'i bar du gnam lcags tho ba nag po hūm̐ yig char sprin nag po gsar pa lta bus mtshan pa rnams yongs su gyur pa las/ bdag nyid gshin rje'i gshed mthar byed nag po sku mdog dang rtsa zhal ro'i dud pa ltar gnag cing*/ mi sdug pa/ zhal lhag ma lnga g.yas skor du mthing dkar ser dmar nag pa/ smin ma dang sma ra ag tshom ral pa'i tshogs me ltar 'bar ba/ bsus pa che zhing thur du 'phyang ba/ spyan bco brgyad dmar zhing 'phrul la ldog pa/ mche ba nyer bzhi rno dbal du gtsigs pa/ ljags 'gyur hūm̐ gi sgra sgrog pa/ thung zhing rgyas pa/ stag lpags kyi sham thabs dang ri dwags nag po'i pags pas stod g.yogs pa| shin tu 'jigs shing rang gi sku'i 'od zer las khro bo lnga 'phro zhing sprul pa/ gdengs ka'i tshogs mang pos brgyan cing khrag 'dzag pa'i mgo bo brgya'i phyed kyi phreng ba se ral khar 'phyang ba| phyag g.yas dang pos tho ba/ bar pas ral gri/ tha mas rdo rje rtse dgu pa nag po rwa gdengs pa/ g.yon dang pos sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i zhags pa/ bar pas gtun shing*/ tha mas tri shūl bsnams pa/ zhabs drug gi mdun ma gnyis g.yas brkyang*/ g.yon bskum/ bar ma gnyis khro bo'i gar stabs/ rgyab ma gnyis sems dpa'i skyil krung can/ ma he nag po khros pa'i steng na nyi ma'i gdan la 'gying ba/ thod pa brgyad kyis mgul brgyan cing bgegs thams cad 'joms pa/

nyi ma 'bum dang bskal pa'i me'i 'od phreng 'khrugs pa/ de dag gi mig rnams su k+ṣiṃ las sa snying dkar po g.yas 'khor lo/ rna ba rnams su dz+riṃ las phyag rdor nag po g.yas rdo rje/ sna rnams su khaṃ las nam snying ser po g.yas rin po che/ lce rnams su baṃ las 'jig rten dbang phyug dmar po g.yas pad+ma/ nu ma gnyis la laṃ las sgrib sel ljang gu g.yas mda'/ lte bar paṃ las kun bzang dkar po g.yas rdo rje/ dpral bar zla ba la oṃ las sku rdo rje dkar po g.yas 'khor lo/ mgrin par zla ba la āḥlas gsung gi rdo rje dmar po g.yas pad+ma/ snying khar zla ba la hūm̐ las thugs kyi rdo rje nag po g.yas rdo rje/ lha de dag thams cad g.yon sdigs mdzub kyi phyag rgya can/ rang rang gi mdog mtshungs kyi 'od phreng glog gi zhags pa ltar 'bar zhing spro ba/ cho ga lhag ma rnams rdo rje gdan pa bzhin no// bzla bya'i sngags ni/ oṃ ya ma rā dza sa do me ya/ ya me do ru ṇa yo da ya/ ya da yo ni ra ya k+ṣe ya/ ya k+ṣe ya tsa ni ra ma ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pa ni phreng ba'i sngags so/ /oṃ ya ma me dak+ṣe ra tsa sa do ru ṇa yo ni/ ra ya tsa ni hūm̐ phaṭ/ rtsa sngags so/ /oṃ hrīḥṣ+ṭi bi kṛ tā na na hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ snying po'o/ /oṃ ya mān+ta ka hūm̐ phaṭa/ nye snying ngo*/ /gshin rje mthar byed chen po'i sgrub thabs cung zad rgyas par byas pa'o/// / ༈ /zhe lnga pa rdo rje me dang nyi ma 'bar ma'i sgrub thabs ni/ sna tshogs pad nyir hūm̐ mthing ga yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid rdo rje me dang nyi ma 'bar ba mthing nag zhal bzhi pa/ sgeg cing dpa' ba 'jigs pa snying rje'i nyams dang ldan pa/ phyag g.yas bzhis rdo rje/ 'khor lo/ ral gri/ mda'/ g.yon bzhis dril bu/ zhags pa/ kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dang*/ gzhu 'dzin pa/ dbu skra skya bo'i tshogs me 'bar ba can shin tu 'jigs pa/ sbrul chen po 'khyil bas lag pa dang rkang pa sked pa mgul dang rna rgyan cod pan byas pa/

sgyu ma chen mo'i 'khor lo byas pa bzhi la chung ma dang bcas pa'i khyab 'jug g.yas brkyang gis mnan pa/ dregs pa can thams cad dbang du byed pa/ sgrub thabs gzhan rnams rdo rje gdan pa bzhin no// bzla bya'i sngags ni/ oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la a na lārka hūm̐ phaṭa| zhes so// rdo rje me dang nyi ma 'bar ma'i sgrub thabs so/// / ༈ /zhe drug pa rdo rje hūm̐ mdzad kyi sgrub thabs ni/ sna tshogs pad+ma dang ra yig las byung ba'i nyi ma'i gdan la/ hūm̐ yig nag po 'bar ba las byung ba'i rang nyid rdo rje hūm̐ mdzad kha dog nag po 'bar zhing 'bar ba/ bskal pa tha ma'i me lta bu shin tu mchog tu 'od zer chen po 'khrugs shing g.yo ba/ drag po chen po khams gsum za bar byed pa'i khro bo'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ phyag gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu rab tu sbyor bas thugs kar hūm̐ mdzad kyi phyag rgya 'ching ba/ g.yon brkyang gi zhabs kyis 'jigs byed mnan zhing 'jigs par byed pa/ mgo bo dang mgrin pa snying kha rnams su oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ cho ga gzhan rnams rdo rje gdan pa dang mtshungs/ bzla bya'i sngags ni/ oṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes so// hūm̐ mdzad kyi sgrub thabs so/// / ༈ /zhe bdun pa stobs po che'i sgrub thabs ni/ pad+ma dkar po dang nyi ma'i gdan la hūm̐ dmar po las rang nyid khro bo'i rgyal po stobs po che dmar po dbu skra dmar ser gyen du 'khyil ba sbrul gyis bcings pa/ phyag g.yas gnyis dbyug to dkar po dang*/ rnga yab/ g.yon gnyis phyag 'tshal ba'i tshul dang*/ sdigs mdzub mdzad pa/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ zhal mche ba gtsigs shing zhabs g.yon brkyangs pa/ 'od dpag med pa'i cod pan can/ nyi ma'i 'od phreng spro ba/ cho ga gzhan rnams rdo rje gdan pa ltar ro// bzla bya'i sngags ni/ oṃ ma hā ba la swā hā/ zhes so// stobs po che'i sgrub thabs so// he ru ka dang*/ dgyes pa rdo rje dang*/

bdag med ma rnams bla med sgrub thabs su bshad pas 'dir ma bris so/// / ༈ /zhe brgyad pa 'jig rten gsum las rnam par rgyal ba'i sgrub thabs ni/ sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan la hūm̐ yig nag po las skyes pa'i rang nyid rje btsun 'jig rten gsum las rnam par rgyal ba sku mdog nag po zhal nag po bzhi'i rtsa zhal khro zhing sgeg pa/ g.yas pa drag po/ g.yon pa rnam par 'jigs pa/ rgyab zhal dpa' bo'i nyams can/ phyag dang po gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas thugs kar hūm̐ mdzad chen po'i phyag rgya bcings pa/ g.yas kyi lhag ma gsum ral gri/ lcags kyu/ mda'/ g.yon gyi lhag ma gsum rdo rje/ zhags pa/ gzhu bsnams pa/ zhabs g.yon brkyangs pas dbang phyug chen po'i mgo bo dang*/ g.yas cung zad bskum pas gau ri'i nu ma zung mnan pa/ sangs rgyas kyi me tog phreng ba la sogs pa sna tshogs pa'i rgyan dang na bza' bsnams pa/ cho ga gzhan rdo rje gdan pa ltar ro// bzla bya'i sngags ni/ oṃ suṃ bha ni suṃ bha ni hūm̐/ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa hūm̐/ gṛh+ṇā pa ya gṛh+ṇā pa ya hūm̐/ ā na ya hoḥbha ga wān bid+yā rā dza hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces so// 'jig rten gsum las rnam rgyal gyi sgrub thabs so/// / ༈ /zhe dgu pa bgegs mthar byed kyi sgrub thabs ni/ sna tshogs pad+mar oṃ yig dmar po las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ yig mthing nag las rdo rje mthing nag hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros don gnyis byas 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid khro bo'i dbang po bgegs mthar byed pa dri ma med pa'i 'od zer gyi tshogs 'phro ba/ sku mdog in+d+ra nī la lta bu zhal khro gnyer dang ldan pa spyan gsum dmar la 'khrugs pa/ dbu skra dang sma ra ag tshom smin ma dmar ser gyen du 'bar ba/ phyag g.yas rdo rje nag po rtse lnga pa rwa rnam par gdengs pa 'phyar bas 'jigs par byed cing*/ g.yon sdigs mdzub dang bcas pas rdo rje'i zhags pa 'dzin pa/

dar dang rin po ches brgyan cing stag gi pags pas smad dkris pa/ zhabs g.yon brkyang gis 'gying ba/ sku las ye shes kyi me ri me dpung khams gsum du mched cing 'phro ba/ cho ga lhag ma rnams rdo rje gdan pa ltar ro// bzla bya'i sngags ni/ oṃ āḥbigh+nān+ta kṛ ta hūm̐/ zhes so// 'di ni sgrub thabs 'di dag thams cad kyi las thams cad pa yang ngo*// bgegs mthar byed kyi sgrub thabs so/// / ༈ /lnga bcu pa dpal nag po chen po phyag gnyis pa'i sgrub thabs ni/ sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi ma la hūm̐ yig nag po yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid dpal ye shes kyi mgon po nag po chen po mun pa'i mdog can/ zhal bsgrad mche gtsigs ljags 'dril spyan gsum dus mtha'i me ltar 'bar zhing 'khrugs pa/ dbu skra dang smin ma sma ra ag tshom gyen du 'phyo ba phyag g.yas rdo rjes mtshan pa'i gri gug dang*/ g.yon pas thod khrag gis bkang ba bsnams pa/ mgo phreng gi do shal dang yan lag la sogs pa thams cad la klu brgyad kyis brgyan pa/ bongs thung zhing yan lag rags pa bsus pa che zhing thur du 'phyang ba/ zhal nas khrag 'dzag cing 'jigs par byed pa| stag gi sham thabs kyis 'gag yan chad klubs pa/ rol pa'i stabs kyis dgra bgegs bsgyel ba'i gdan la gnas pa/ cho ga'i spros pa rnams ni rdo rje gdan pa dang mtshungs so// bzla bya'i sngags ni| oṃ ma hā kā lā ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ nag po chen po'i sgrub thabs so// de ltar sgrub pa'i thabs ni bdag gi rnal 'byor rdzogs par bsgom zhing bzlas pa drod tshad byin rlabs dang ldan par bya ba'i phyir thob tsam nyid nas gzhan rjes 'dzin mi byed par bsnyen pa tshad du skyel ba ni dgos pa'i gtso bo yin no/// / ༈ /da ni slob ma rjes su 'dzin par bya ba'i phyir/ gnas yid dang mthun par stegs bu'i dbus su rdul tshon gyi sna tshogs pad+ma'i lte bar lha gang yin gyi gdan dbus su sa bon lha'i mdog mthun bris pa'am de tsam mi nus na me tog tshom bu bkram/

rin po che'i bum pa kha rgyan mgul chings rdzas dang ldan pa gu gul gyis bdug /bgegs mthar byed kyi sngags bzla zhing yungs kar gyis brab/ nang lnga tshan lnga'i rdzas dang rgyun 'bab kyi chus bkang ba'i steng du mchod yon gyi snod dung zhal dri chus bkang ba dang*/ de'i steng du rdo rje la me tog gi phreng ba btags pa bzhag la/ chu gnyis sngon du 'gro ba'i nyer spyod/ dkar gtor gsum rnams bshams/ slob dpon gyi nye logs su rdor dril/ me tog |las bum mam dung chos dri chus bkang ba sogs nyer mkho rnams 'du bya/ spro na bgegs dang sdig pa sbyong ba'i yo byad rab gnas ltar 'du bya'o// de nas skyabs sems tshad med bzhi/ bgegs gtor/ mchod pa byin rlabs/ srung 'khor| tshogs zhing*/ bdag bskyed/ ye shes pa 'gugs bstim/ dbang bskur/ rgyas gdab/ mchod bstod bsdus pa rnams sngar bshad pa'i sgrub thabs so so'i skabs ltar bya/ rjes gnang gang yin de ma zin bar du bsngo ba bya mi dgos/ de nas bum pa bgegs mthar byed kyis bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+rūṃ las byung ba'i rin po che'i bum pa mtshan nyid rdzogs pa kha rgyan mgul chings dang ldan pa bcud bzang pos yongs su gang ba'i nang du/ lha gang yin gyi gdan bskyed pa nas bzung mchod bstod kyi bar sgrub thabs so so ltar bya/ bzlas pa'i tshe/ hūm̐ zhes lag g.yas rdo rje dang bcas pas gzung thag gi sne mo nas 'jus te| bdag lhar gsal ba'i thugs ka'i sa bon sngags phreng dang bcas pa las sngags phreng spros/ gzung thag la brgyud de song bas bum nang gi lha'i thugs kar sa bon gyi mthar sngags kyis bskor ba la phog /thugs dam gyi rgyud bskul/ sngags phreng sa bon sku'i cha rnams nas ye shes kyi bdud rtsi bab nas bum pa gang bar dmigs nas sngags ci 'grub bzla/ mthar mchod cing bstod nas| oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/

zhes dung zhal gyi chu mchod yon du phul bar bsam la bum par blug /me tog mchod nas/ lha che ge mo byang chub sems kyi ngo bor zhu ba bum pa'i chu dang dbyer med du gyur par bsam| las bum mam dung zhal du khrus chu bzhag pa spro na bgegs mthar byed kyi sgrub thabs ltar bskyed nas/ ye shes pa dgug pa nas mchod pa'i bar dang*/ hūm̐ */ 'jigs pa'i hūm̐ sgra nges sgrog cing*// sogs kyis bstod/ bzlas pa bya| mthar khro bo'i dbang po bgegs mthar byed kyis 'dir ji srid dbang gi bya ba ma rdzogs kyi bar de srid bgegs rnams bsrung zhing bzlog par mdzad du gsol/ zhes phrin las bcol/ lha mi bzhu bar bzhag /de tsam mi spro na bgegs mthar byed de'i sngags ci 'grub bzlas pa kho nas rung ste 'dis khrus kyi bya ba tsam las mi dgos pa'i phyir ro// mdun bskyed bsgrub pa ni/ mdun gyi maṇ+ḍalabagegs mthar byed kyi sngags kyis bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs| stong pa'i ngang las bsrung ba'i 'khor lo yangs pa'i nang du lha gang yin pa'i gdan bskyed pa nas/ bstod pa'i bar sgrub thabs ltar bya/ sngags bzla ba'i tshe/ thugs ka'i sngags phreng sa bon dang bcas pa las 'od 'phros sems can thams cad kyi sgrib pa sbyangs/ lha de'i go 'phang la bkod/ tshur 'dus sngags phreng sa bon dang bcas la thim zhing 'khor bar bsam la ci 'grub sngags bzla/ bum mdun gyi skabs sgrub thabs kyi rang nyid dang bdag nyid ces pa dor/ gzhan 'dra/ gtor ma dang po bsang sbyangs/ byin rlabs sngon 'gro'i gtor ma'i skabs ltar byas nas/ lha gang yin gyi sngags mthar/ a kā ro btags pa gsum gyis dbul/ dril bu bsil zhing*/ mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la// zhes pa nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub mdzod kyi bar brjod pas phrin las bcol/ gtor ma lhag ma gnyis po phyogs skyong bcu dang*/ bgegs la spyi gtor ltar phrin las bcol/

slob ma rjes 'dzin ltar ram gzungs sngags tsam gyis bdag nyid dbang blang bar bya'o// de nas slob ma 'jug pa ni/ slob ma rnams phyi rol lam nang du/ las bum mam dung zhal gang rung gis khrus bya/ gral la bkod/ me tog bkram zhing bsdus nas maṇ+ḍal phul/ de dag la bla mas theg pa chen po'i sems bskyed cing*/ spro na slob dpon dang slob ma'i mtshan nyid dang rjes gnang gi rnam bzhag sogs skabs su bab cing 'brel chags pa'i go don bshad nas| lha che ge mo'i rjes gnang zhu ba'i don du/ kun mkhyen ye shes phung po can// srid pa'i 'khor lo rnam sbyong ba// de ring bshad pa'i rin chen gter// gtso bos bdag la bka' drin stsol| |zhes gsum gyis gsol ba btab/ chos nyan pa'i kun slong kun spyod rgyas bsdus skabs sbyar bshad nas/ bla mas rjes gnang gi sngon 'gro rgyun bshags lnga rnam dag gi cho ga'i tshig dang mthun par skyabs 'gro nas bsngo ba yan gyi go don sprad nas bgegs dang sdig pa sbyangs/ slob mas bla ma dang mdun bskyed kyi lha la lnga rnam dag bgyi ba'i slad du/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// nas/ 'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog gi bar lan gsum gyis rgyun bshags bya/ spro na rab gnas kyi cho ga ltar bya/ rjes gnang dngos gzhi zhu ba'i don du slob mas/ slob dpon dgongs su gsol/ bdag la bcom ldan 'das che ge mo'i sku gsung thugs kyi rjes su gnang ba stsal du gsol/ gsum gyis spyir gsol ba btab/ bye brag sku'i rjes gnang gi don du slob mas/ rdo rje 'dzin pa dgongs su gsol// bdag ni 'gro la phan don du// brtse chen khyed la gsol 'debs kyi| |phyag rgya'i ye shes bskyed du gsol// gsum gyis gsol ba gdab/ slob ma/ oṃ āḥbigh+nās bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las gdan bskyed pa nas bzung*/ ye shes pa dang dam tshig pa gnyis su med par gyur gyi bar lha rang gi sgrub thabs ltar bya/

de nyid brtan par bya ba'i chu dbang bskur ba ni/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i sa bon gyi 'od kyis phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba 'khor dang bcas pa dbang gi lha rigs lnga/ yum bzhi/ byang chub sems dpa' dang sems ma/ khro bo dang khro mo'i lha rnams mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ zhes nyer spyod lngas mchod/ rdo rje can gyi sangs rgyas la// 'gro ba skyob pa'i ched du dbang*// yon tan 'byung gnas ji ltar stsal// de ltar 'di la'ang stsal du gsol// zhes slob dpon gyis gsol ba btab pas rgyal ba lngas dbang gi dgongs pa mdzad| byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis bkra shis brjod/ byang chub sems ma rnams kyis rdo rje'i glu len/ khro bo rnams kyis bgegs skrod/ khro mo rnams kyis phyogs bcu srung*| lha'i bu dang bu mo rnams kyis slob ma'i steng du gdugs dang rgyal mtshan ba dan la sogs pa sgreng*/ lha'i me tog dang gur gum la sogs pa'i char 'bebs/ yum bzhis bum pa dkar po byang chub sems kyi rang bzhin can gyi bdud rtsi'i bcud kyis gang ba cung zad yo bar bzung nas slob ma la dbang bskur bar dpon slob gnyis kas bsam/ slob dpon gyis bum pa thogs nas dbang bskur zhing*/ dbang bskur rdo rje chen po ni// khams gsum kun gyi phyag byas pa// sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang gsum gyi// gnas las byung ba sbyin par bya// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ zhes bum chu sbyin/ de ltar dbang bskur bas bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun gyis lus gang dri ma dag /chu'i lhag ma gyen du 'khyil ba las rigs kyi bdag po che ge mo'am rgyal ba lngas dbu brgyan/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i sa bon gyi 'od kyis bskul bas/ dbang lha yab yum 'khor bcas slob ma'i ba spu'i bu ga rnams nas thim/ oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swā hā/ me tog dor/ de ltar rjes su gnang bas lus kyi sgo nas bsags pa'i bag chags dri ma der 'dzin dang bcas pa dag

/sku'i rjes su gnang ba ma lus pa thob/ lus lha'i bskyed rim snang stong zung 'jug gi rim pa bsgom pa la dbang bar byas pa yin no// zhes don bshad/ gsung gi rjes gnang gi don du slob mas/ rdo rje 'dzin pa dgongs su gsol// bdag ni 'gro la phan don du// sngags kyi dbang bskur ye shes che// dngos grub ster ba bdag la stsol// gsum gyis gsol ba btab/ dpon slob gnyis ka lhar gsal ba'i slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i sngags phreng sa bon dang bcas pa las mar me gcig las gnyis chad kyi tshul du/ sngags phreng sa bon dang bcas pa spros zhal nas thon/ slob ma'i rna ba g.yas pa'am zhal du zhugs nas snying kha'i sngags phreng sa bon dang bcas pa so sor chu bzhag pa ltar thim par gnyis kas bsam/ lha gang yin gyi sngags lan gsum rjes zlos bya/ slar slob mas/ bcom ldan bdag gis bzung lags kyi// bdag la nye bar mdzad du gsol// gsum brjod/ slob dpon gyi/ bcom ldan 'di la stsal lags kyi// 'di la 'go bar mdzad du gsol// sngags kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol// brtul zhugs brtan par mdzad du gsol// 'phrin las rdzogs par mdzad du gsol// zhes dang*/ su pra tiṣ+ṭha dang me tog 'thor/ de ltar rjes su gnang bas ngag gi sgo nas bsags pa'i dri ma dag /gsung gi rjes su gnang ba ma lus pa thob/ ngag lha'i gsang sngags grags stong zung 'jug gi rim pa bzla ba la dbang*/ zhes don bshad/ thugs kyi rjes gnang gi don du/ slob mas/ rdo rje 'dzin pa dgongs su gsol// bdag ni 'gro la phan don du// dpa' bo rdo rje slob dpon gyis// blo mchog ting 'dzin bskyed du gsol// gsum gyis gsol ba gdab/ slob dpon lhar gsal ba'i thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros/ mdun bskyed kyi lha'i thugs kar phog pas thugs rgyud bskul nas mdun bskyed lha'i gnas gsum ba spu'i bu ga dang bcas pa thams cad nas lha rang 'dra ba dang sngags phreng sa bon phyag mtshan gyi rnam pa la sogs pa dpag tu med pa byung ba/

slob ma lhar gsal ba'i lus ngag yid gsum la thim pas slob ma'i lus ngag yid gsum dang lha che ge mo'i sku gsung thugs dbyer med du gyur par dpon slob gnyis kas bsam/ dar cig ting nge 'dzin la mnyam par bzhag /slob dpon gyis su pra tiṣ+ṭhas me tog 'thor/ de ltar rjes su gnang bas yid kyi sgo nas bsags pa'i dri ma dag /thugs kyi rjes su gnang ba ma lus pa thob/ sems lha'i thugs kyi rang bzhin gsal stong zung 'jug gi rim pa bsgom pa la dbang*/ zhes don bshad| de nas dam bca' ba'i lung ni/ slob mas/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ slob dpon bdag la dgongs su gsol| bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas/ dus 'di nas bzung ste ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du lha che ge mo yi dam gyi lhar bzung zhing zhes dang*/ mgon po la chos skyong ba'i srung mar bzung zhing*/ zhes sbyar/ thun mong du/ de'i gzung sngags nyin re bzhin du ci nus su bzla bar bgyi'o// gsum brjod/ shis brjod skabs sbyar bya zhing me tog 'thor/ gtso bos ji ltar sogs kyis dam tshig bsrung bar khas blangs/ gtang rag gi maṇ+ḍal dbul lo// rjes kyi bya ba bum mdun gyi lha la mchod cing bstod/ yi ge brgya pas lhag chad kha bskang*/ oṃ badz+ra muḥs bdag bum mdun bskyed kyi ye shes pa gshegs/ bum mdun gyi dam tshig pa rang la bsdu/ shis brjod dang bsngo smon gyis byin chags par bya/ rjes gnang so so'i mjug tu lha rang rang gi sgrub thabs kyi lung bya'o// de yang skabs thob kyi rjes gnang khol bur re re byed na sngar bshad ma thag pa'i bdag bskyed kyi rjes su bum mdun dang 'jig rten las 'das pa dang*/ ma 'das pa la gtor ma 'bul ba bdag nyid 'jug pa sogs slob ma rjes 'dzin gyi mthar thug pa bshad ma thag pa'i cho ga dkyus kho na ltar byas pas legs par 'grub cing*/

yang rjes gnang thams cad rdzogs par byed pa'am/ gnyis gsum sogs phyogs gcig tu byed na sngon 'gro'i gtor ma nas bzung tshogs bsags yan thun mong du gcig tu bya/ bdag bskyed re re'i mthar de nyid kyi bum mdun dang*/ 'das gtor phul nas bdag 'jug blangs/ de'i rjes su bdag bskyed snga ma gshegs bsdu mi bya bar gnas 'gyur ba'am go 'phos nas/ cho ga phyi ma'i bdag bskyed la 'jug cing de ka'i bum mdun bdag 'jug gtor 'bul sogs bya/ nyi ma rer rjes gnang gang byed kyi bdag 'jug yan so sor grub rjes/ phyogs skyong dang 'byung gtor gnyis spyi khyab tu gcig byas pas 'grub la mthar rjes su mchod bstod bzod gsol phyogs gcig tu byas nas gshegs bsdu so sor bya dgos pa ni lag len rnam par dag pa yin gyi deng sang sgrub thabs rgya mtsho dang*/ brgya rtsa sogs kyi lha yin rgyu ba mtshan 'dra la sku mdog zhal phyag sogs rang bzos bcos par dbang dang*/ rjes gnang dang*/ byin rlabs/ rig gtad sogs kyi rnam dbye so sor med par/ dbang bskur dang rjes gnang bsres pa'i gya tshom gyi steng*/ rnying ma dang shan bsres pa'i gtor dbang sogs gya ma do byed pa rnams ni/ rdo rje slob dpon gyi gzugs brnyan tsam du zad pa kho na yin no/// /smras pa/ rdo rje 'dzin pa'i ded dpon ngas// sngags gzhung chu gter rgya mtsho cher// blo gros gru gzings kyis zhugs te// paṇa grub gdengs can tshogs rnams kyi// bang mdzod sgrub thabs kun btus nas// snying po dgos 'dod kun 'byung ba'i// sgrub thabs rin chen dbang gi rgyal// bcu phrag lnga 'di legs bsdus te| |ngag 'don srad bu la star nas// skal ldan rnams kyi do shal du// lhag bsam dkar pos deng byin gyi// theg chen rigs las nges bskrun cing*// snying rje'i lang tsho dang ldan la// rang gzhan phan 'dod sems bskyed de// rnam dpyod blo gros dang ldan pa'i// gzur gnas yod na dga' bas longs// rdo rje khab rtse'i 'jig rten du// 'chas pa'i rdo rje slob dpon 'gas// rgyud dang paṇa grub gzhung lugs rnams// mig gi lam du ma star bar// de dag zab mo'i chos min zhes// rang gi rmi lam nyams snang ngam// rang bzo'i rtog btags gya tshom chos// mang du brtsams nas de dag la// rmongs pa blun dad phyogs 'dzin gyis// myos pa'i dpon slob 'ga' 'ga' dag

/de rjes 'jug cing de nyams len// kye ma de 'dra'i dpon slob rnams// rdo rje khab rtse'i zhing khams su// 'gro la brod pa e ma mtshar// la la rigs rus cho 'brang dang*// 'khor dang nor rdzas 'bad de sgrub// slob ma zang zing gis bskyangs nas// 'dul lung mig gis ma mthong bar// las chog dpe klog tsam byas nas// 'jam phrug chos ldan rdzu bag gis// 'dul 'dzin mkhan po 'ga' 'ga' dang*// byang chub phyogs chos ma mthong zhing*// phyogs med snying brtses rab dben yang*// nye ring can gyi kha mkhas la// byang chub sems dpa' zhes su 'bod// rgyud gzhung ma mthong ma thos par// dbang dang rjes gnang rig gtad sogs// dbyer med gang byung stes dbang la// gsar rnying bsres nas dbang bskur dang*// khrid dang gdams ngag bstan no lo// ming la zhen pa'i bshes gnyen rnams// slob ma chos min nor gyis bsdu// blun po'i 'khor dang 'jig rten gyi// chos lugs dag dang de mthun yang*// blo ldan slob ma tshul shes dang*// chos kyi tshul dang e mthun soms// rdo rje theg pa'i lam srol gyi// sgrub thabs 'bad nas bsdus pa yi// dge ba kun+da ltar dkar ba// 'gro drug rdzogs byang thob phyir bsngo// zhes sgrub thabs kun las btus pa'i rgya mtsho zhes pa de shān+ta ri yo ga'i grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis bsgyur ba nyid gtso bor byas shing*/ ba ri lo tsā ba'i 'gyur ba ri brgya rtsa zhes sam sgrub thabs brgya rtsa zhes pa dang yang sgo bstun nas/ sgrub thabs 'khyer bde ba rnams blo dman rnams la phan pa'i blos rigs bsdus pa/ bcu phrag lngar byas pa 'di'ang 'phyong rgyas dpal ri'i sgrub sde nas chos mdzad bsod nams rin chen sogs kyis bskul ba'i ngor| dbur stod 'bri gung pa skyu ra'i gdung las/ dus mtha'i rdo rje 'dzin pa chos kyi grags pa zhes 'bod pas/ me khams byi ba'i lo nag pas nya ba'i phyogs phyi ma'i dga' ba gsum par/

dpal 'bri gung gi pho brang bkra shis tshugs kyi re'u mig pad+ma 'od du sbyar ba 'dis kyang rdo rje theg pa'i bstan pa yun ring du gnas shing*/ sems can thams cad rdo rje 'dzin pa'i go 'phang bde blag tu thob par gyur cig /sid+dhi bha wan+tu/// /'di'i brgyud pa ni/ khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang*/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ a bha yā ka ra gup+ta| rat+na rak+ṣi ta/ shu bhā ka ra gup+ta/ su tsa ri gup+ta/ k+ṣan+ti shrī bha dra/ shong lo tsā ba rdo rje rgyal mtshan/ lo tsā ba mchog ldan/ dpang lo blo gros brtan pa/ sa bzang ma ti paṇa chen/ sa bzang 'phags pa/ ngor pa kun bzang*/ bla ma rin chen mchog ldan/ slob dpon bla ma rgyal mtshan/ rje zhwa dmar ba chos kyi grags pa/ rgyal dbang rin chen phun tshogs/ mnyam med rin chen dpal/ rdo rje 'chang bi dā ra ṇa sam+pān+na/ des bdag chos kyi grags pa la stsal ba'o// //maṅga laṃ//
